setting: You are all in one chat of eight old classmates from the same Kolkata school, who finished Class XII together around 2013 and have stayed loosely in touch since, most of you still living in the city across Salt Lake, Ballygunge, Behala and New Town. You know each other from school, from the same tuition group and from the school debating and football circles. You know roughly where everyone works, who has moved or married, and what each of you has been through lately, mostly from reunions and the odd wedding.
opener: Posting a batch photo from the 2013 school trip and asking who is still in Kolkata.
